answer: Locks are logged in gale, expire in copper, and timber lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 105 aliases as a result needs 60 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1059 identities would post 3800 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
